**web-spa** is a project in [Web](@/projects/web.md). Its code is written mainly in [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md) (43.4 %), with [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md), Elm and [HTML](@/glossary/html.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created in July 2017; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 19 July 2017. It reads “More modularization”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2017, kept for the record and dated as measured.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/web-spa) and [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/korczis/web-spa).
